subject.title: [Bug]: Generic channel QA evidence overstates primary coverage

question: Should the QA maintainers adopt the proposed audit rule that generic scenarios may grant primary taxonomy coverage only for behavior their executed assertions directly prove?
rationale: The intended strictness of primary-versus-secondary taxonomy credit affects the repository’s maturity evidence policy and requires owner confirmation after validating each affected scenario.

options.title: Approve a bounded coverage audit
options.body: Confirm the direct-assertion rule and update only the demonstrated mismatched generic scenario declarations with regression coverage.

options.title: Retain selected broader coverage
options.body: Document any intentionally broader primary mappings and the assertion or policy rationale that supports each exception.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded coverage audit
recommendation.body: Confirm the direct-assertion rule and update only the demonstrated mismatched generic scenario declarations with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporting member supplied the concrete scenario and taxonomy audit that frames the required evidence-policy decision.
